title: Radius Raid
description: Survive swarms of enemies in a neon space arena with powerups and escalating waves.
instructions: Move with WASD or arrow keys. Aim and fire with the mouse. F toggles autofire, P pauses, M mutes.
licenseNotes: Original visuals and audio are procedurally generated. JSFXR audio synthesizer: Apache-2.0, license included.
